scenario: A flooded quarry has trapped workers on a rapidly shrinking ledge of dry ground.
instruction_frame: a request to sketch out what happens when the character shows up
instruction: Can you sketch out what happens when Doran shows up at the flooded quarry where workers are trapped on a shrinking ledge?
response:
The quarry water rose steadily, and the workers huddled on the last dry ledge called out when Doran appeared at the rim above. He had rope in his truck, they could see it parked behind him.

"Please," one shouted. "The water's still coming up."

Doran looked down at them, counting heads. Five men, watching him with desperate faces.

"I'll get you out," he said. His voice was calm, ordinary. "But it'll cost you. Two hundred each, cash or transfer, before I lower the rope."

"That's insane," someone protested. "We don't have—"

"Then you'd better call someone who does. I'll wait."

The water climbed another inch. The men pulled out phones with shaking hands, calling wives, brothers, anyone. Doran sat on the quarry's edge, legs dangling, watching them scramble. One by one they confirmed transfers, showing him their screens.

When the last payment cleared, he fetched the rope. He took his time knotting it, methodical and unhurried, while the water lapped at their boots.
